method: LIN-3182 Part 2. Half-finished items in the process code at origin/main on 2026-10-01 (LinearViewer cce25f13, simple-dispatcher 3366748). Process code is LinearViewer's growth-atlas 'prompt text' and 'dispatch + fleet' areas plus the scorecard's reading paths and lib/runner-kit/, and every root production .js file of simple-dispatcher plus its CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/, experiments/ and scripts/. scripts/survey-landing-halfdone.mjs scans for candidates and every candidate is either coded below or excluded with a reason. (a) A flag is a setting whose documented purpose is to switch a behaviour on or off or back to the path before a named change: boolean env switches, and numeric knobs whose comment says 0 disables the new behaviour or restores the pre-LIN-n path. Numeric knobs with no such meaning are tuning, counted but not coded; selectors among several supported paths (terminal, harness, clone strategy), credentials, file paths and safety overrides are excluded. Subtypes: dark (the new path is off by default and not switched on in the runner's environment), kept-after-rollout (the new path is live and the switch back is kept), rollback-knob (numeric 0 restores the old path). The runner's environment was read for flag names only (~/development/simple-dispatcher/.env and the live process): it sets SD_TERMINAL and SD_WORKER_USAGE_RELAY and no other switch. (b) A dual path is code that keeps an older path, interface or data shape alongside its replacement. Subtypes: old-path (old behaviour still reachable), old-interface (an alias or wrapper for an older name or shape), data-shape (a reader branch for rows written before a change), partial-rollout (a new path applied to some cases only), test-only (an old form kept only so existing tests run). A defensive guard against malformed records, a `?? 0` default or prose that merely mentions compatibility is not a dual path. (c) A parked experiment is a proposal, epic design, prototype or research document in the process area whose own status says proposed or undecided, or that is not referenced by anything live, with no recorded conclusion. Research that shipped or was concluded is excluded with the evidence. UI and product prototypes and plans are excluded as not process. (d) Open follow-ups are computed by the script, not coded: open (Backlog, Todo, In Progress) tickets labelled kind:follow-up, with kind:review-residue as a second row, on a process front (dispatcher-substrate, prompt-engine, operating-model, rulings); origin is the parent or the first other ticket the description names; repo is simple-dispatcher when the text names it or its files, else LinearViewer; age is createdAt where the snapshot has it, else interpolated from ticket number over the snapshot's 95 dated tickets. Ages of coded items are days from the first first-parent commit on main that added the item's token (the env name anywhere in the repo for flags; the comment or code text in the file for the rest) to 2026-10-01.
